title: Constantly Sick After Daycare Starts: What Parents Can Do

blocks.narration: If your child started daycare and now you feel like you are constantly sick, it can be exhausting.
visual_keywords: parent caring for child at home

blocks.narration: When children begin group care, they are exposed to more viruses and bacteria, and the whole family can get sick more often.
captions: more germs for the whole family

blocks.narration: But months of repeated stomach pain, cramping, and diarrhea should not be dismissed as just the daycare effect.
captions: But months of stomach pain and diarrhea

blocks.narration: Making an appointment with a GI specialist is a good step, and while you wait, a simple symptom log can help.
captions: Seeing a GI specialist is a good step
A symptom log can help while you wait

blocks.narration: Write down what you eat, when pain or diarrhea happens, and whether any other symptoms appear.
That record can help your doctor understand the pattern more clearly when you finally have your appointment.
captions: Your notes can help your doctor
